quote.text: What man can you show me who places any value on his time, who reckons the worth of each day, who understands that he is dying daily? For we are mistaken when we look forward to death; the major portion of death has already passed, Whatever years be behind us are in death's hands.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Each day with your children is a treasured moment; recognize that every hour is an opportunity to impart love, wisdom, and support.
    • Embrace the awareness of time’s fleeting nature by creating lasting memories and genuine connections with your family.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, value each decision as if it were a critical moment in time—every choice influences future outcomes and the team’s legacy.
    • Lead with the mindset that every passing day is an asset; invest it in cultivating trust, vision, and the well-being of your community.
  • Product Management
    • Recognize that every iteration in your project represents a step forward; time is a finite resource, so prioritize and iterate with care.
    • Channel the urgency of valuing time into fostering a culture of continuous improvement and strategic decision-making in your team.
